citation: PCI Security Standards Council standard (contractual, not law)
basis: The owner is the merchant of record and the merchant agreement requires PCI DSS compliance and card brand rules. PCI SSC sets no size tiers and no exemption for sole proprietors. The processor's portal assigned SAQ A. About 3,600 card orders a year, about 2,000 of them Visa, which is Visa Level 3 (1 to 1,000,000 Visa transactions a year)

obligation: FTC Act Section 5 (unfair or deceptive practices)
basis: The FTC may act against 'persons, partnerships, or corporations' (45(a)(2)), so it reaches a sole proprietor with no size threshold. The business holds about 14,000 patron records and publishes a privacy notice

obligation: FTC Rule on Unfair or Deceptive Fees (under N71-R05)
basis: 'Business' includes an individual and 'covered good or service' includes live-event tickets (464.1). The owner offers and advertises ticket prices on event pages, posts and flyers
The website and ticketing pages are general audience, and checkout requires buyers to confirm they are 18 or older; no online service is directed to children

obligation: ADA Title III ticketing rules (accessible seating)
basis: The Room is a place of public accommodation that sells assigned seats for about 12 seated shows a year, including accessible seating price levels

obligation: Florida Information Protection Act (reasonable measures, breach notice, disposal)
basis: 'Covered entity' names a sole proprietorship (501.171(1)(b)). About 85% of the 14,000 patron records have a Florida ZIP code

applies: Yes (817.36(5) protects the owner); No for the 817.36(1) resale limits

About 15% of buyers have ZIP codes outside Florida, so a breach could reach residents of other states
